description: The group's authoritative attendance outcome for an event.

main.description: The group's authoritative attendance outcome for a community.lexicon.calendar.event with a capacity: who got a place and who is on the waitlist, in order. Authored by the group in the event's calendar space. The rkey must equal the rkey of the event (a TID).

event.description: The community.lexicon.calendar.event this outcome is for.

going.description: DIDs of the members who have a place, in rsvp order. Absent means nobody.

waitlist.description: DIDs of the members waiting for a place, first in line first. Absent means nobody.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the record was created.
